github.Khatmax AI.config.anthropic.conte:
Select the context editing mode for Anthropic models. Automatically manages conversation context as it grows, helping optimize costs and stay within context window limits.

- `off`: Context editing is disabled.
- `clear-thinking`: Clears thinking blocks while preserving tool uses.
- `clear-tooluse`: Clears tool uses while preserving thinking blocks.
- `clear-both`: Clears both thinking blocks and tool uses.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature. Context editing may cause additional cache rewrites. Enable with caution.
github.Khatmax AI.config.anthropic.promp:
Use the extended (1 hour) prompt cache TTL on tools and system blocks for the Anthropic Messages API. Applied to Claude Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7 and Sonnet 4.5/4.6 variants; other models keep the default 5 minute TTL even when this setting is enabled.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature. Only the main agent conversation is eligible — inline chat, terminal chat, notebook chat, and subagent requests are excluded.

Also extend the 1 hour prompt cache TTL to message-level breakpoints. Requires `chat.anthropic.promptCaching.extendedTtl` to be enabled; has no effect on its own.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature.
github.Khatmax AI.config.modelCapability:
Per-model capability overrides keyed by model id, intended for evaluating preview and tenanted models against an existing model's capability profile. For each model id, declare an aliased `family`. Setting `family` to a known production family (e.g. `"claude-opus-4.7"`) makes the model receive that family's full capability profile — Anthropic family detection, latest Opus prompt, multi-replace tools, tool search, context editing, extended cache TTL — without a code change.

**Note**: This is an advanced setting for evaluation use; it is not intended for regular end-user configuration.
github.Khatmax AI.config.useResponsesApi:
Use the Responses API instead of the Chat Completions API when supported. Enables reasoning and reasoning summaries.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature that is not yet activated for all users.

**Important**: For Custom Endpoint models, the API type is independent of this setting and is determined per-model via the `apiType` property, or inferred from the `url` path when omitted.
github.Khatmax AI.config.responsesApiCon: Enables context management for the Responses API. Requires `#github.Khatmax AI.chat.useResponsesApi#`.
github.Khatmax AI.config.responsesApi.pr: Enables prompt cache key being set for the Responses API.
Enables explicit prompt cache breakpoint markers for the Responses API.
github.Khatmax AI.config.updated53CodexP: Enables the updated prompt for gpt-5.3-codex model.
github.Khatmax AI.config.claude48OpusPro: Enables the updated system prompt tuned for the Claude Opus 4.8 model.
github.Khatmax AI.config.claudeSonnet5Pr: Enables the updated system prompt tuned for the Claude Sonnet 5 model.
github.Khatmax AI.config.gpt55GetChanged: Enables the Get Changed Files tool for gpt-5.5 models.
github.Khatmax AI.config.gemini3GetChang: Enables the Get Changed Files tool for gemini-3 models.
github.Khatmax AI.config.gemini3LowReaso: Sets the reasoning effort to low for gemini-3 models.

github.Khatmax AI.config.anthropic.tools:
Enable Anthropic's native web search tool for BYOK Claude models. When enabled, allows Claude to search the web for current information. 

**Note**: This is an experimental feature only available for BYOK Anthropic Claude models.
Maximum number of web searches allowed per request. Valid range is 1 to 20. Prevents excessive API calls within a single interaction. If Claude exceeds this limit, the response returns an error.
